sloka: रामोऽपिदारयेदेषां बाणेनैकेन च द्रुमम् ।वालिनं निहतं मन्ये दृष्ट्वा रामस्य विक्रमम् ॥४-११-७१॥।।
transliteration: rāmo'pidārayedeṣāṁ bāṇenaikena ca drumam ।vālinaṁ nihataṁ manye dṛṣṭvā rāmasya vikramam ॥4-11-71॥।।

translations.english: 'If I see Rama splitting these trees with one arrow, I will believe he can kill Vali with his prowess.
